name: dsh-pai-terrain
description: DSH plugin for code intelligence via Terrain service. Provides `pai_terrain_ops` tool with actions: index, refresh, search, read, overview, projects, unregister, source, init, ask. Connects to Terrain service (port 7878) for code indexing and queries. Indexing is free (no LLM); ask/init require TERRAIN_ALLOW_LLM=1.
